headline: Microsoft Offers Buyouts to 60,000 Employees in Cost-Cutting Move
summary: Microsoft is offering voluntary buyouts to approximately 60,000 workers as part of its latest cost-cutting initiative following previous waves of layoffs.
why: Microsoft is the world's largest software maker and a dominant player in cloud computing and enterprise technology. Workforce reductions at this scale impact operating margins and tech sector employment trends.

impacts.name: Microsoft
impacts.why: Lower operating expenses from workforce reductions can support profit margins over the medium term.

why_moved: Large-scale workforce buyouts at a mega-cap technology firm directly affect cost structures and operational efficiency, drawing significant investor attention.
